title: Code Width Bound
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, with $k$ work tapes and state set $Q$. Put $H=3(|Q|+1)$ and $C=2(2(H+3k+1))+2$. For natural numbers $n,E$, if $2C\le E$, then $C\big((n+2)^E+\log_2(n)+1\big)\le(n+2)^{2E}$, where $\log_2(n)$ denotes the natural-number logarithm appearing in the definition of logarithmic space.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
Twice the code parameter $C$ is at most $E$
